# Public real-run regression evidence

Click run [33760631267](https://github.com/pallets/click/actions/runs/33760631267),
job 100665765259, Python 3.13, September 3 2026.

The JSON contains real run/job metadata, the historical workflow and an excerpt
of the original job log. Checkout SHA, setup-python version and failure details are
retained. Authentication credentials are not present. The fixture is used for resolver
regression; running the fixture alone does not count as a real local reproduction.

Original Click workflow/log material is covered by the adjacent Click license.
